title: Host
description: A member of the sync mesh. engine: syncthing (default) is a live P2P device; engine: rclone is a remote (cloud storage, another NAS, ...) reached via scheduled rclone bisync from the anchor host.

name.description: Stable logical name. Used as the key in folders/*.paths.

engine.description: What powers this member. syncthing = live mesh device; rclone = bisync'd remote.

remote.description: rclone remote name as configured in rclone.conf on the anchor host. Required (and only allowed) when engine: rclone.

ip.description: LAN IP, useful for direct connections when discovery is unreliable.

host.description: Hostname or IP to SSH into when it differs from the host's primary hostname/ip (e.g. a Parallels shared-network address).

key_ref.description: Reference to a private key path on the operator's machine (NOT committed).

binary_path.description: Absolute path to the Syncthing binary. Required for winget+nssm installs.

home_dir.description: Absolute path to Syncthing's config + database directory. Required for winget+nssm installs.

api_url.description: Reachable URL of this host's Syncthing REST API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8384 when tunnelled).

api_key_ref.description: Pointer into a sops-encrypted file: path#key. Resolved at runtime.

rclone.description: Optional rclone rcd info — typically only on the cloud-edge (anchor) host.
